title: Computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
summary: Google announced computer use capabilities for Gemini 3.5 Flash, enabling the AI model to interact with and control computer interfaces to perform complex multi-step tasks autonomously. This represents a significant step in agentic AI, allowing models to move beyond text generation to actually executing tasks through software interfaces.
problem_solved: Enables AI models to autonomously interact with software applications and perform complex computer-based tasks that traditionally required human operators.
why_valuable: Transforms AI from a text-based tool into an actionable assistant that can navigate interfaces, execute workflows, and complete real-world computer tasks, dramatically expanding practical AI applications.
